# BHU-DRISHTI

> BHU-DRISHTI is the internal Land Acquisition Intelligence and Decision
> Control Tower used by the Department of Land Resources (DoLR), Ministry of
> Rural Development, Government of India, to monitor statutory land acquisition
> workflow under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land
> Acquisition Act, 2013 (RFCTLARR Act, 2013).
>
> This is a restricted departmental system. It is not a public service and the
> pages below require authenticated access.

## Notes

- **Access:** staff authentication required; requests are not publicly crawlable.
- **Statutory basis:** RFCTLARR Act, 2013.
- **Data:** demonstration data is bundled with the application; live parcel
  records are served by the backend API and never exposed to crawlers.

## Application

- [Login](/): officer sign-in for departmental and field staff.
- [Control tower](/): statutory workflow status, bottleneck alerts and the GIS
  parcel map for active acquisition projects.

## Optional

- [Health check](/health): backend liveness endpoint.
